issues.description:
## Problem

`mise exec -- pnpm validate:ux-final` is the remaining blocker for QQP-441 after the Book Cinema responsive budget was repaired in QQP-542.

Fresh report: `output/final-ux-gates/latest/final-ux-summary.md`

Observed final UX status:

* 12/13 gates passed.
* Failed gate: UI action audit is review-complete or explicitly waived.
* Blocking failed activations:
  * `workspace-preview-generation-failed`: timeout waiting for `Audio does not match the current source, voice, policy, or scope`.
  * `workspace-preview-asr-warning`: timeout waiting for `localized-preview-playback-toolbar`.
* Duplicate registry debt:
  * 73 unclassified duplicate action groups.
  * 31 overexposed duplicate groups with burn-down owners.
  * 8 needs-consolidation duplicate groups.

## Acceptance

* `mise exec -- pnpm validate:ux-final` passes, or any intentionally remaining UI-action findings have explicit repo/Linear waivers with owners and review dates.
* Scenario inventories for `workspace-preview-generation-failed` and `workspace-preview-asr-warning` are deterministic.
* Duplicate action groups are either removed, classified in the waiver registry, or moved to explicit burn-down owner/issues.
* Do not relax Book Cinema canvas budgets or QQP-542 responsive evidence.

## Linked blocker

Blocks QQP-441 final closeout. QQP-542 resolved the responsive Book Cinema theatre budget blocker separately.

issues.title: Book Cinema Theatre compact phone controls exceed canvas budget
issues.description:
Blocks QQP-441: [QQP-441](https://linear.app/niklas-olsson/issue/QQP-441/first-batch-active-processing-and-canonical-fixture-evidence-gate)

RCA: real product/UI failure, not stale budget or harness bug.

Evidence:

* `mise exec -- pnpm e2e:book-cinema:responsive` fails at `book:phone-390:theatre`.
* Footer measures `343px` / `40.64%` viewport; compact budget allows max `188px` / `25%`.
* Canvas height is `31.85%`; compact read/theatre budget requires `43%`.
* Blocker screenshot: `output/e2e-book-cinema/screenshots/responsive-book-phone-390-theatre.png`.
* `frontend/src/features/cinema/canvasBudget.ts` defines the product budget; `CinemaShell.tsx` publishes it as `data-cinema-*`; the E2E harness reads that live budget.

Likely source:

* `frontend/src/features/cinema/CinemaTheatre.tsx` / theatre transport renders duplicated mini progress/status plus full `LocalizedPlaybackToolbar`.
* `frontend/src/features/playback/LocalizedPlaybackToolbar.tsx` may need a compact/action-only theatre variant.

Acceptance:

* Keep `canvasBudget.ts` thresholds unchanged unless demonstrably impossible after a real compact UI fix.
* Phone Book Cinema Theatre visible controls fit budget: footer <= `188px` and <= `25%`, canvas >= `43%` viewport.
* Avoid duplicate progress/status in compact theatre mode.
* `mise exec -- pnpm e2e:book-cinema:responsive` passes.
* `mise exec -- pnpm --filter @tts-research/frontend test` passes.
* `mise exec -- pnpm check` passes.
* If screenshots/UI evidence changes are committed, `mise exec -- pnpm review:chatgpt` passes.

Scope note:

* QQP-441 remains evidence-only and should only rerun/collect final evidence after this UI repair lands.
